name: Return to Chromie
label: Quest
description: Return to Chromie: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have gathered many relics of the battle of Darrowshire. Each time you returned with more, my heart yearned for my village... Yearned to protect it from its fate.
I know that cannot be, but Chromie, that strange gnome in Andorhal, tells me it is possible. She says you can save Darrowshire!
She asked me to gather together the relics, and to have you bring them to her. She said that she awaits you in the ruined inn of Andorhal.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I have been in contact with your friend Carlin. He feels great pain for the doom of his village, but he speaks very highly of you and knows that you can set things right.
Oh, but I'm drifting from the subject at hand... Friend, do you have the relics I asked for?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah yes, there they are. Together they weave a powerful spell, one that will raise the spirits of Darrowshire.
With that spell, and with a little luck, we can save Joseph Redpath!
